_about: JungKG seed graph v1 — Jung's alchemy, grounded in Collected Works paragraphs.
_citation_key: Every § anchor was located in the actual text (see extract.py). 'verified' = human sign-off (Damian), starts false. 'confidence' = machine read (high/medium/low). 'claim_type' = provenance: jung-asserts (his own claim) | jung-reports-parallel (a cross-tradition parallel he draws) | jung-quotes-source (he quotes a named source, given in 'source'). Quotes kept <=15 words, safe to publish.

nodes.label: Mother Archetype / Great Mother
nodes.vocabulary_note: This node collapses a distinction CW 9i §148 and §188-189 draw explicitly: the mother ARCHETYPE (the a priori structure) versus the Great Mother (its mythological image, the archetype receded furthest from consciousness: mother -> grandmother -> Great Mother). Both readings route through this node; recorded 2026-08-08 per the standing one-node-one-note rule.
